title: 第一卷 第7章 戒指老爷爷第一卷 第8章 木老的震惊
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
此刻的顾天阳，白衣胜雪，黑发如瀑，负手而立。
在他身上，三位长老感受到的不再是少年人的青涩。
而是一种执掌乾坤、睥睨天下的无上气魄！
大长老顾青云的嘴唇哆嗦着，喉咙发干，艰难地吞咽了一口唾沫。
他死死盯着顾天阳，心中掀起了惊涛骇浪。
“这绝不是普通的凝气境！”
“远不止表面上这凝气境修为那么简单！”
二长老顾青海更是虎目含泪，方才的屈辱，此刻已被激动所取代。
他从顾天阳的眼中，看到的不是年少轻狂的鲁莽，也不是色厉内荏的虚张声势。
而是一种绝对的自信！
“难道天不亡我顾家？”
一个念头从二长老心底升起。
三长老顾青河下意识地看向顾天阳那双深邃的眼眸。
那双眼眸平静依旧，却仿佛蕴藏着两轮炽盛的骄阳，目光所及，一切虚妄皆成灰烬。
“在他身上，究竟发生了怎样惊世骇俗的蜕变？”
“仅仅十日啊！”
“这股自信，究竟从何而来？”
顾天阳那股浩瀚如海的威压只是一闪而逝，便被他完美地收敛入体内，仿佛从未出现过。
大厅内那令人窒息的压迫感随之消散，只留下三位长老心有余悸的喘息声。
他们看着主位上那位白衣少年，明明容貌未改，却感觉像是换了一个人。

那是一种源自生命层次和灵魂本质的蜕变，沉稳如山，深邃如渊。
顾天阳将三位叔叔的反应尽收眼底，心中了然，心念微动。
“系统，探查我三位长老的详细情况。”

content_en:
At this moment, Gu Tianyang, dressed in white as snow, with black hair like a waterfall, stood with his hands behind his back.
In him, the three elders no longer felt the youthfulness of a young man.
Rather, it is a supreme courage to control the world and look down upon the world!
The Great Elder Gu Qingyun's lips were trembling, his throat was dry, and he swallowed hard.
He stared at Gu Tianyang, feeling a storm in his heart.
"This is definitely not an ordinary Qi Condensation Realm!"
"It's much more than just the Qi Condensation Realm cultivation on the surface!"
The second elder, Gu Qinghai, had tears in his eyes. The humiliation just now had been replaced by excitement.
What he saw in Gu Tianyang's eyes was not the recklessness of youth, nor was it the bravado of a tough-looking person.
But an absolute confidence!
"Will God destroy my Gu family?"
An idea arose from the heart of the second elder.
The third elder, Gu Qinghe, subconsciously looked into Gu Tianyang's deep eyes.
Those eyes were still calm, but they seemed to contain two blazing suns. Everything within sight turned into ashes.
"What kind of shocking transformation happened to him?"
"It's only ten days!"
"Where does this confidence come from?"
Gu Tianyang's vast sea-like pressure just disappeared in a flash, and was perfectly absorbed into his body, as if it had never appeared before.
The suffocating sense of oppression in the hall dissipated, leaving only the frightened breathing of the three elders.
They looked at the young man in white at the main seat. Although his appearance had not changed, they felt like a different person.
It is a transformation originating from the level of life and the essence of the soul, as steady as a mountain and as deep as an abyss.
Gu Tianyang had a clear view of the three uncles' reactions, and he understood clearly, and his thoughts moved slightly.
"System, explore the details of my three elders."
